Amherst, Massachusetts2 contributions

Cheep and Delicious
Oct 2017 • Solo
This Restaurant is the best cheep eat in the old quarter, with prices of 10-25 dong you can't go wrong with a Banh Mi Zoon as you enjoy the night life of Hanoi. The only down side to this restaurant is the fact that they have no seating but food more then makes up for it. Something I don't like about Banh mi 25 for example is that it is usual dry but that is not a problem with here because they smother it with there special zoon sauce. I highly recommend this restaurant.
